section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Frauenfeld; other communes differ) and church tax
label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Frauenfeld; other communes in Thurgau set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Thurgau)
label: Who levies it
value: The canton (57% of the yield goes to the political municipality)
note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
source_title: Thurgau Steuergesetz (StG, RB 640.1), Stand 1. Januar 2025 (version in force until 31 December 2026), Liegenschaftensteuer
